تزدهفون (form VIII)
# تَزْدَهِفُونَ (tazdahifūna) /taz.da.hi.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَهَفَ (izdahafa)
# تُزْدَهَفُونَ (tuzdahafūna) /tuz.da.ha.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَهَفَ (izdahafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
